overview: This chapter details the operational mechanisms of a small transformer, encompassing its training processes (self-attention and backpropagation), generalization strategies via regularization, post-training memory optimization through quantization, and enhanced reasoning capabilities utilizing retrieval-augmented generation.
topics: Backpropagation for prediction improvement during training
Regularization for generalization beyond training examples
Quantization for reducing memory requirements after training
